title: Denosumab or Zoledronic acid for erosive hand osteoarthritis (EHOA) in patients with osteoporosis a randomized controlled trial (ZODIAC trial)
official: Denosumab or Zoledronic acid for erosive hand osteoarthritis (EHOA) in patients with osteoporosis a randomized controlled trial (ZODIAC trial)
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the reduction in the progression of erosion volume in the denosumab group vs zoledronic acid group

interventions.name: Obodence 60 mg solution for injection in pre-filled syringe

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Men ≥50 years of age and post-menopausal women with osteoporosis naïve to any anti-osteoporosis medication candidate to treatment to either denosumab of zoledronic acid
2. Subjects with hand OA having suffered from transient inflammatory attacks of the interphalangeal finger joints characteristic for what has been termed ‘inflammatory’ or ‘erosive’ hand OA.
3. Subjects with hand OA showing inflammatory signs, either clinically or ultrasonographically, of the interphalangeal finger joints
4. Subjects with hand OA in which at least 1 interphalangeal finger joint has the typical appearance on the X-rays of a ‘J’ or ‘E’ phase joint as defined by the criteria mentioned above
5. Able and willing to give written informed consent and to comply with the requirements of the study protocol.
6. A baseline BMD T-score of ≤ -2.5 at the lumbar spine, total hip, or femoral neck or baseline T-score of ≤-2.0 at the lumbar spine, total hip, or femoral neck + a prevalent MOF fracture
7. Signed informed consent for participation in the study and for the processing of personal data
Exclusion criteria:
1. No past IV bisphosphonates at any time, or any oral bisphosphonate use within 12 months before screening
2. No past treatment with denosumab
3. Malignancy within the last 5 years (except cervical carcinoma in situ or basal cell carcinoma or localized squamous cell carcinoma of the skin)
4. Hypocalcemia below lower limit of normal (LLN)
5. Estimated glomerular filtration rate < 35 mL/minute/1.73 m^2 at the time of screening/randomization
6. Intolerance to calcium supplements, vitamin D supplements
7. Contraindication to, or poorly tolerant of denoosumab therapy (including hypersensitivity to the drug and any excipients)
8. Contraindication to, or poorly tolerant of zoledronic acid therapy (including hypersensitivity to the drug and any excipients)
9. Recipient of an investigational drug within 4 weeks prior to study drug administration or within 5 half-lives of the investigational drug, whichever is longer
10. Not a good candidate for study participation in opinion of investigator
11. No past treatment with other anti-osteoporosis medications (romosozumab, PTH analogs, SERMs etc.)
12. History of atypical femur fracture
13. Unstable systemic medical condition
14. Uncontrolled hyperthyroidism
15. Uncontrolled hypothyroidism
16. History of Addison disease
17. History of osteomalacia
18. History of osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ)
19. History or presence of inflammatory or erosive arthritides other than erosive hand osteoarthritis (EHOA), including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, crystal-induced arthritis, connective tissue disease-related arthritis, and spondyloarthritis
20. Active osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ), unhealed oral surgery, active dental infection, or planned urgent invasive dental procedure that is considered incompatible with safe initiation of study treatment
21. History of anorexia nervosa, bulimia (by history or physical) or obvious malnutrition
22. History of Paget’s disease of bone
23. Other bone diseases which affect bone metabolism
24. Vitamin D deficiency [25(OH) vitamin D level < 20 ng/mL (<49.9 nmol/L)
25. Hypercalcemia >10% above upper limit of normal (ULN)
26. Elevated transaminases or total bilirubin ≥ 2.0 x ULN
27. History of any solid organ or bone marrow transplant
